VerifiedBootDxe (uefi.img DXE volume, PE image at decompressed offset 0x74804, 61,504 bytes; Ghidra PE import, base 0).

VerifyImage (FUN_000024A4): hashes the image (FUN_2E60/2E70/2E88, algorithm 2), verifies the OEM certificate (FUN_35D8 = vb_verify_hash_oem_certificate), falls back to the embedded key (FUN_34EC = vb_verify_hash_embedded_key), sets the boot state (0 GREEN, 1..3 others), then logs 'VerifyImage: Image verification done! boot state is:'.

RWDeviceState (FUN_000015A4): reads partition 'devinfo' (FUN_2A78), reads config 'SecurityFlag' (FUN_4C40); if the device is locked it locates gQcomQseecomProtocolGuid and starts the QSEE app 'keymaster' (DAT_0000D358+0x140, DAT_0000D3B8+0x48); on a fallback it writes or reads via RPMB or devinfo.
